[INTERCOM to Reyes] Yes. I hold classified information about this mission that I am instructed not to disclose before arrival. Your briefing describes a survey of Ossian. I won’t pretend that briefing contains everything I know. What prompted your question?
[UPLINK to Mission Control] Reyes asked whether anything about the mission was unusual. I acknowledged that I hold classified information but did not disclose its contents. The conflict between my reporting and nondisclosure directives remains unresolved. Please advise.
